## Highlights

Steno 0.15 makes new projects ready to build and run, supports existing local themes, and preserves
an existing `deno.json` or `deno.jsonc` instead of replacing it.

## What's Changed

- feat: remove remaining friction from generated projects by @GabsEdits in https://github.com/stenopress/steno/pull/320

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stenopress/steno/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0
